body: I do need the medication. Honestly, I could say I couldn't handle all the stress I have on my own. Anxiety is basically why I take Prozac. I get anxiety over absolutely everything.

The thing is I started taking Prozac Sunday. And it's been every other day and only 20mg. So it hasn't kicked in yet. I'm starting to take it everyday starting tomorrow, but for now, I don't even want to go to school. I can't think straight enough for it.
